qualifying_findings.title: COSCUP session frames coding-agent harnesses as enforceable trust boundaries
qualifying_findings.date_basis: visible event schedule date on the source page
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: The session explains that Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and OpenAI Codex rely on an external harness to organize context, execute tool calls, manage permissions, restrict operating scope, and preserve session or execution state. It contrasts model-driven planning and tool selection with external enforcement for permission, sandbox, credentials, resource limits, audit records, test results, and recovery.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: This is a direct local-practice signal for harness architecture: as prompts and fixed workflows shrink, teams still need external controls for sandboxing, approvals, auditability, verification results, and recovery rather than trusting the model to self-enforce consequential boundaries.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Candidate ingest should update or cross-link harness leaves around model/external-system separation, sandbox and permission enforcement, audit-log capture, test-result evidence, session persistence, and recovery mechanisms while routing product/model details upstream.
follow_up_notes: Treat the event schedule date as an in-window visible date, but verify whether a recording, slides, or source repository appears before durable synthesis.
If synthesized, avoid restating broad product comparisons; keep the durable page focused on harness-enforced trust boundaries.

qualifying_findings.title: Algorithms and Programs promotes AI-checkable outlines as specification practice
qualifying_findings.date_basis: visible publication date on Google Books listing
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: Google Books lists Eric Braude's Algorithms and Programs: An AI-Assisted Approach as published by Addison-Wesley Professional on August 7, 2026. The description says the book replaces traditional pseudocode with precise algorithm outlines that define intended outcomes, support correctness reasoning and invariants, and align with AI-assisted development tools.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: The local practice signal is specification shape: AI-assisted coding benefits from structured, outcome-oriented algorithm outlines that can be translated into code and checked against correctness conditions, rather than vague natural-language prompts or loosely maintained pseudocode.
named_entities: Algorithms and Programs: An AI-Assisted Approach
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Candidate ingest should connect outcome-oriented algorithm outlines to executable PRD templates, TDD acceptance criteria, and verification/eval rubrics for generated implementations.
follow_up_notes: Before durable synthesis, prefer the publisher page or preview text if available to verify whether the AI-assisted practice guidance is substantial beyond the listing description.
Keep broad book/entity metadata upstream-owned; local wiki should preserve only the specification and verification implication.

qualifying_findings.title: Dubai AI Hub hackathon uses coding agents with codebase-health judging
qualifying_findings.date_basis: visible event date and same-day end status on the source page
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: The competition summary describes a one-day August 8, 2026 voice-agent hackathon where teams build with AI coding agents, integrate live web data, submit a demo video and repository link, and are judged on agentic engineering and codebase health.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: The local signal is adoption workflow design: even short AI-agent build events are asking for repository evidence and codebase-health review, not only demos, which supports using reviewable artifacts and quality gates in AI-assisted training and adoption exercises.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Candidate ingest should route this to adoption and verification patterns for workshop or hackathon exercises: provide accounts early, require repository submission, make codebase health an explicit judging criterion, and preserve demo artifacts as review evidence.
follow_up_notes: The page appears to be a summarized competition listing rather than the official event page; verify the official competition page if available before durable synthesis.
Do not create local product leaves for sponsors; route sponsor/product details upstream.
